mapper.select: SELECT ar.*, r.name as resource_name, r.status as resource_status FROM appointment_resources ar LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id WHERE ar.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY ar.resource_type, ar.resource_id
